verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers the open-source CLI, the skill, the proxy and plugin compatibility, but nothing documents an update path. There is no marketplace auto-update, no explicit update or upgrade command, and no versioning guidance. Update paths are a fair question for a CLI/skill product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch
